words.ex: The movie was incredible.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影太棒了。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as incredible, you like them very much or are impressed by them, because they are extremely or unusually good.

words.tr: n. 局外人；无取胜希望者；
words.ex: He felt like an outsider at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上感觉像个局外人。
words.en: An outsider is someone who does not belong to a particular group or organization.

words.ex: He won the chess tournament last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周赢得了国际象棋锦标赛。
words.en: A tournament is a competition in which players who win a match continue to play further matches in the competition until just one person or team is left.

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.ex: The company will publicise the new product next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周宣传新产品。
words.en: To publicise something means to make it widely known to the public, especially by using the media.

words.ex: He tweaked the volume to make it louder.
words.ex_cn: 他微调了音量，让它更大声。
words.en: To tweak something means to make a small change to it in order to improve it or make it work better.

words.ex: He can customise his phone with new themes.
words.ex_cn: 他可以用新的主题自定义他的手机。
words.en: If you customise something, you change its appearance or functionality to suit a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: The website offers customisation for user profiles.
words.ex_cn: 该网站提供用户资料的定制功能。
words.en: The act of modifying something to suit a particular individual or task.

words.ex: The modification improved the design.
words.ex_cn: 这个修改改进了设计。
words.en: A modification is a change or alteration made to something to improve it or to make it suitable for a different purpose.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.ex: He eats spaghetti for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃意大利面。
words.en: Spaghetti is a type of pasta that is long, thin, and solid, originally from Italy.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.ex: He hit the ball with topspin.
words.ex_cn: 他击球时加了上旋。
words.en: A spin given to a ball in which the top of the ball rotates forward in the direction of travel, making the ball drop more sharply than normal.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: The doctor checked his gut for signs of infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的肠道是否有感染迹象。
words.en: The gut refers to the stomach and other internal organs of an animal or person, often used to describe the digestive tract. It can also metaphorically represent courage or determination.

words.ex: The intestine helps digest food.
words.ex_cn: 肠道帮助消化食物。
words.en: The part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus.

words.ex: This bag is durable and lasts for years.
words.ex_cn: 这个包很耐用，可以用很多年。
words.en: Something that is durable is strong and lasts a long time without breaking or becoming weaker.

words.tr:
n. 杂交种；混合物；
adj. 混合的；
words.ex: The corn hybrid grows faster than the old type.
words.ex_cn: 这种玉米杂交种比旧品种长得更快。
words.en: A hybrid is a plant or animal that has been produced from two different types of plant or animal, especially to get better characteristics. It can also refer to something that is a mixture of two different things.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.tr: v. 效劳；服务；为……工作；招待；
words.ex: He serves the community as a volunteer.
words.ex_cn: 他作为志愿者为社区效劳。
words.en: To perform duties or services for (a person or an organization).

words.tr:
n. 紧握；掌握；控制；
v. 紧握；掌握；
words.ex: He has a strong grip on the handle.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧握住把手。
words.en: To grip something means to hold it tightly. It can also mean to hold someone's attention completely.

words.ex: I anticipate rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我预料明天会下雨。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.ex: The pirate sailed the sea with a black flag.
words.ex_cn: 海盗带着黑旗在海上航行。
words.en: A pirate is someone who attacks and robs ships at sea. The term can also refer to someone who illegally copies and distributes software, music, or films.

words.tr: n. 不适合的东西；不适应环境的人
words.ex: That old chair is a misfit in the new room.
words.ex_cn: 那把旧椅子在这个新房间里格格不入。
words.en: A misfit is a person who is not suited to a situation or who does not fit in well with the other people in a group.

words.tr:
adj. 蛮勇的；鲁莽大胆的
n. 鲁莽大胆的人
words.ex: He is a daredevil rider who jumps over cars.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个蛮勇的骑手，会跳过汽车。
words.en: A daredevil is someone who enjoys doing dangerous things and taking risks.

words.ex: He went on an adventure in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他去丛林里冒险。
words.en: An adventure is an exciting experience or undertaking that is typically bold, sometimes risky.

words.tr: n. 虚张声势的人; 流氓; 冒险家
words.ex: He acts like a swashbuckler to impress his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他为了给朋友留下印象而装出一副虚张声势的样子。
words.en: A swashbuckler is someone who behaves in a very bold and confident way, often in a way that is intended to impress other people. They are often associated with adventure and daring deeds.

words.tr:
v. 潜行以觅食；窥伺；逡巡于
n. 悄然潜行；四处觅食；徘徊
words.ex: The cat will prowl around the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 猫会在晚上在房子周围徘徊。
words.en: To move around quietly in a place trying not to be seen or heard, especially when you are looking for something or someone.

words.ex: The soldiers raided the enemy camp at night.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在夜间突袭了敌人的营地。
words.en: A raid is a sudden attack on a place by soldiers, police, or other officials, in order to search for something or to arrest someone.

words.tr: v. 可能；也许；“may”的过去式； n. 强大力量；
words.ex: He might come to the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚可能会来参加派对。
words.en: Might is used to indicate that something is possible or might happen, or to ask for permission in a polite way.

words.ex: The navy launched a large fleet to protect the coast.
words.ex_cn: 海军派出了一支大型舰队来保护海岸。
words.en: A fleet is a group of ships or vehicles that are controlled by one company or organization and are used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: We must eliminate the waste to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须消除浪费以保护环境。
words.en: To eliminate something, especially something you do not want or need, means to remove it completely.

words.ex: The government wants to eradicate poverty.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望消灭贫困。
words.en: To eradicate something means to get rid of it completely.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.ex: The queen's reign lasted 70 years.
words.ex_cn: 女王的统治持续了70年。
words.en: The period during which a sovereign rules; to hold royal office; to prevail

words.ex: The cave paintings predate written history.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画早于文字历史。
words.en: To exist or occur at a date earlier than something else.

words.ex: The city is predominantly populated by young people.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市主要由年轻人居住。
words.en: If something is predominantly true, it is true to a much greater extent than it is false.

words.tr: adj. 肥沃的；有繁殖力的；多产的；富饶的；
words.ex: The fertile land grows many crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片肥沃的土地长满了各种作物。
words.en: Land or soil that is fertile is able to support the growth of a large number of strong healthy plants.

words.ex: The hikers walked on a rugged trail.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者走在一条崎岖的小路上。
words.en: A rugged area of land is uneven and covered with rocks, with few trees or plants.

words.ex: He possesses a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

words.ex: He comes from a seafaring family.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个航海世家。
words.en: Seafaring relates to travelling by sea, especially as a job or as a way of life.

words.ex: Her singing voice is unsurpassed.
words.ex_cn: 她的歌声无可匹敌。
words.en: If you describe something as unsurpassed, you mean that it is better than anything else of the same kind.

words.ex: The boat stopped in a small cove near the island.
words.ex_cn: 船停在岛附近的一个小海湾里。
words.en: A cove is a small type of bay or coastal inlet. Coves usually have narrow, restricted entrances, are often circular or oval, and are often situated within a larger bay.

words.ex: The spy remained undetected for years.
words.ex_cn: 这名间谍多年未被发现。
words.en: Not discovered or noticed; not detected.

words.tr: adj. 可航行的；适于通航的；
words.ex: The river is navigable by small boats.
words.ex_cn: 这条河可供小船航行。
words.en: If a stretch of water is navigable, it is deep and wide enough for ships to travel through.

words.ex: He will surrender when he sees the police.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到警察时，他会投降。
words.en: If you surrender, you stop fighting or resisting someone and agree that you have been beaten.

words.ex: He feared retaliation after speaking against the boss.
words.ex_cn: 他因反对老板而害怕遭到报复。
words.en: Retaliation is the act of returning an injury or wrong, especially by inflicting harm in return for harm received.

words.ex: The pyramids were built over millennia.
words.ex_cn: 这些金字塔是在数千年间建造的。
words.en: Millennia is the plural form of millennium, which refers to a period of a thousand years.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.ex: He defeated his opponent in the chess game.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: An opponent is someone who is competing against you in a contest, game, or argument, or someone who is opposed to an idea or plan.

words.ex: He joined the navy after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他高中毕业后加入了海军。
words.en: The navy is the part of a country's armed forces that is trained to operate at sea.

words.tr:
n. 海港；
v. 庇护；窝藏；
words.ex: The ship docked at the harbour at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 船在日落时停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbour is an area of water next to the coast where ships and boats can shelter.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.tr:
v. 提取；
n. 摘录；提取物；
words.ex: They extract oil from plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们从植物中提取油。
words.en: To remove or take out something, especially by effort or force.

words.ex: He is a diplomatic ambassador who handles international relations.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位处理国际关系的外交大使。
words.en: Diplomatic means relating to diplomacy or diplomats, or using skill and tact in dealing with people.

words.ex: They maintain correspondence through letters.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过信件保持通信联系。
words.en: Communication by exchanging letters with someone; a close similarity, connection, or equivalence.

words.ex: The pharaoh built a big pyramid.
words.ex_cn: 法老建造了一座巨大的金字塔。
words.en: A pharaoh was a king in ancient Egypt, considered a god as well as a political leader.

words.tr: adj. 大量的；重大的；实质性的；
words.ex: He made a substantial profit from the sale.
words.ex_cn: 他从这次销售中获得了大量的利润。
words.en: Something that is substantial is large in size, amount, or importance.

words.ex: The storm caused a disruption in the train service.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴扰乱了火车服务。
words.en: Disruption is a situation in which something is prevented from continuing in its usual way because of problems or difficulties.

words.ex: Small commerce helps local towns grow.
words.ex_cn: 小商业有助于小镇的发展。
words.en: Commerce is the activity of buying and selling things, especially on a large scale.

words.ex: The teacher will not condone cheating in exams.
words.ex_cn: 老师不会容忍考试作弊。
words.en: To condone something means to accept or allow behavior that is considered wrong.

words.ex: The movie glorifies violence as heroism.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影美化了暴力，将其视为英雄主义。
words.en: To glorify someone or something means to praise them or make them seem more important or better than they really are.

words.tr: adj. 大胆的；勇敢的； v. “dare”的现在分词；
words.ex: He made a daring jump off the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 他大胆地从桥上跳了下去。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as daring, you mean that they are willing to do things which might be dangerous or which might shock or anger other people.

words.tr: n. 演说者；演讲者；雄辩家；
words.ex: He is a famous orator who speaks at large events.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位在大型活动中演讲的著名演说者。
words.en: An orator is a person who delivers speeches or lectures, especially one who is skilled at doing so.

words.ex: He is an ambassador to France.
words.ex_cn: 他是驻法国的大使。
words.en: An ambassador is an official envoy, especially a high-ranking diplomat who represents a state and is usually accredited to another sovereign state or to an international organization as the resident representative of their own government or sovereign or appointed for a special and often temporary diplomatic assignment.

words.ex: We took a detour to avoid the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们绕道以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A detour is a longer, less direct way to go somewhere, used to avoid a problem or to visit something along the way.

words.tr:
v. 记录；准确地描述；俘虏；吸引；
n. 抓捕；
words.ex: The camera can capture the moment clearly.
words.ex_cn: 相机可以清晰地记录下这一瞬间。
words.en: To capture someone or something means to catch them, especially after a chase.

words.tr:
adj. 开明的；自由主义的；
n. 自由党党员；
words.ex: He is a liberal teacher who listens to students.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位开明的老师，会倾听学生的声音。
words.en: A liberal person, system, or policy is one that is in favour of allowing people a lot of freedom in their behaviour or opinions.

words.ex: The school will curtail recess time during exams.
words.ex_cn: 学校在考试期间将缩短课间休息时间。
words.en: If you curtail something, you reduce or limit it.

words.tr:
v. 阻碍；妨碍
n. （带盖）篮子
words.ex: Rain hampered our picnic plans.
words.ex_cn: 雨妨碍了我们的野餐计划。
words.en: If something hampers you, it makes it difficult for you to do something.

words.ex: We made an arrangement to meet at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排好晚上六点见面。
words.en: An arrangement is a plan or preparation which you make so that something can happen.

words.ex: The police caught the culprit who stole the bike.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了偷自行车的罪犯。
words.en: A culprit is someone who has done something wrong or illegal.

words.tr: v. 鼓励；使有胆量；鼓励，使有胆量( embolden的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The success emboldened her to try again.
words.ex_cn: 这次成功鼓励她再次尝试。
words.en: If you are emboldened by something, it makes you feel confident enough to behave in a particular way.

words.tr:
v. 绑架；劫持；诱拐
n. 绑架罪
words.ex: The man tried to kidnap the little girl.
words.ex_cn: 这个人试图绑架那个小女孩。
words.en: To take someone away illegally by force, typically to obtain a ransom.

words.ex: The dignitary gave a speech at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 这位显要人物在仪式上发表了演讲。
words.en: A dignitary is a person who has an important position in a society or an organization.

words.ex: The kidnappers asked for a ransom of $1 million.
words.ex_cn: 绑匪要求一百万美元的赎金。
words.en: A ransom is the money that is demanded for the release of a person who has been kidnapped.

words.ex: The robbers took a hostage during the bank robbery.
words.ex_cn: 劫匪在银行抢劫时抓了一名人质。
words.en: A hostage is someone who has been captured by a person or organization and who may be killed or injured if people do not do what that person or organization demands.

words.ex: The turtle outlives the rabbit.
words.ex_cn: 乌龟比兔子活得长。
words.en: To live longer than someone else; to survive something.

words.ex: They made a concerted effort to clean the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们共同努力清理了公园。
words.en: A concerted action or effort is done by several people or groups working together.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.tr:
v. 防止；战斗；抑制；
n. 战斗；
words.ex: The new law aims to combat pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律旨在防止污染。
words.en: Combat refers to fighting, especially during a war. It can also mean to try to stop something harmful from happening or increasing.

words.ex: The broken bridge is a menace to drivers.
words.ex_cn: 这座破桥对司机来说是个危险物。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a menace, you mean that they are likely to cause serious harm.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.ex: The troop marched into the town at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 部队在黎明时分进入城镇。
words.en: A troop is a group of soldiers or a large group of people or animals.

words.ex: The small town has a maritime history.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有着海洋历史。
words.en: Relating to the sea, especially in relation to seaborne trade or naval matters.

words.ex: He deliberately broke the rule.
words.ex_cn: 他有意地违反了规则。
words.en: If you do something deliberately, you do it intentionally or after thinking about it carefully.

words.tr: adj. 不可避免的；必定的；
words.ex: It is inevitable that the sun will rise tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳明天一定会升起。
words.en: If something is inevitable, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.ex: There are roughly 100 students in the class.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级大约有100名学生。
words.en: In a manner that is not exact or detailed; approximately.

words.ex: He gave a verbal warning instead of a written one.
words.ex_cn: 他给了一个口头警告，而不是书面的。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of words.

words.ex: He deceived his friend with a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个谎言欺骗了朋友。
words.en: If you deceive someone, you make them believe something that is not true, usually in order to get some advantage for yourself.

words.ex: It is apparent that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is apparent, it seems to be true, although you cannot be certain that it is.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.ex: He inadvertently dropped the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他非故意地打翻了玻璃杯。
words.en: If you do something inadvertently, you do it without realizing it, or by accident.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.tr:
n. 织布机；
v. 迫近；
words.ex: The old loom made a loud clicking sound.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧织布机发出很大的咔嗒声。
words.en: If something looms over you, it appears as a large or unclear shape, often in a way that is frightening or causes worry.

words.tr: v. 促进；使便利；使容易；
words.ex: The teacher facilitates learning by asking questions.
words.ex_cn: 老师通过提问来促进学习。
words.en: To make an action or process easier or more likely to happen.

words.ex: He was unduly harsh on his son.
words.ex_cn: 他对儿子过于严厉。
words.en: If you say that something does not happen or is not done unduly, you mean that it does not happen or is not done to an excessive or unnecessary extent.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.tr: adj. 令人信服的； v. “compel”的现在分词；
words.ex: His story was compelling and made everyone listen.
words.ex_cn: 他的故事令人信服，让所有人都认真聆听。
words.en: A compelling argument or reason is one that makes you believe it or accept it because it is so strong.

words.tr:
v. 达到；抵达；
n. 伸手可及的距离；
words.ex: He reached his goal after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的努力，他达到了自己的目标。
words.en: To reach means to arrive at a place, especially after spending a long time or a lot of effort traveling. It can also mean to stretch out an arm in order to touch or grasp something, or to achieve a goal or a standard.

words.ex: His speech was persuasive and made everyone agree.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲很有说服力，让所有人都同意了。
words.en: A persuasive argument or reason is one that makes you believe that something is true or right.

words.ex: He cannot comprehend the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To comprehend something means to understand it fully.

words.ex: The lotion can sensitize your skin to sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这种乳液会使你的皮肤对阳光敏感。
words.en: To make someone or something sensitive to a particular substance or condition.

words.tr: n. 效用；实用；公用事业；
words.ex: The utility of this tool is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具的效用非常高。
words.en: Utility refers to the state of being useful, profitable, or beneficial.

words.ex: Children need literacy to read books and write letters.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们需要有读写能力才能读书和写信。
words.en: Literacy is the ability to read and write.

words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.ex: Climbing the mountain was an arduous task.
words.ex_cn: 爬山是一项艰巨的任务。
words.en: Something that is arduous is difficult and tiring, and involves a lot of effort.

words.ex: The cost of maintenance is low for this car.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维持费用很低。
words.en: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.

words.ex: The team reached a consensus on the project plan.
words.ex_cn: 团队就项目计划达成了共识。
words.en: A consensus is general agreement among a group of people.

words.tr: adj. 单个的；单数的；特异的；
words.ex: Each singular student must submit a form.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都必须提交一份表格。
words.en: In grammar, singular means relating to or being a form of a word that refers to one person or thing.

words.ex: He thinks this new pill is a panacea for all diseases.
words.ex_cn: 他认为这种新药是治百病的万应药。
words.en: A panacea is a remedy for all diseases or ills.

words.ex: The country has an agrarian economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家有一个农业经济。
words.en: Relating to land, especially agricultural land, or to the ownership or division of such land.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: The atmospheric pressure dropped before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，大气压下降了。
words.en: Relating to the atmosphere of the Earth or another planet; creating a distinctive mood, typically of romance or nostalgia.

words.tr:
v. 抽水；打气；
n. 泵；抽水机；打气机；
words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.tr:
pron. 我的（东西）；
n. 矿；
v. 采矿；
words.ex: This book is mine.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我的。
words.en: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with the speaker. A place where minerals are extracted from the earth. To extract minerals from the earth.

words.ex: He adapted to the new school quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就适应了新学校。
words.en: To make suitable to or fit for a specific use or situation.

words.tr: n. 中风；划水动作；一击；
words.ex: He had a stroke last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年中风了。
words.en: A stroke is a medical condition in which poor blood flow to the brain results in cell death. It can also refer to an act of hitting or striking someone or something, or a gentle movement of the hand over a surface.

words.ex: The piston moves up and down in the engine.
words.ex_cn: 活塞在发动机中上下移动。
words.en: A piston is a component of reciprocating engines, reciprocating pumps, gas compressors and pneumatic cylinders, among other similar mechanisms. It is the moving component that is contained by a cylinder and is made gas-tight by piston rings.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.ex: The rotary switch turns on the light.
words.ex_cn: 旋转开关打开灯。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by rotation.

words.ex: The motion of the ball is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 球的运动非常快。
words.en: The action or process of moving or being moved.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.ex: The locomotive pulled the train down the track.
words.ex_cn: 机车拉着火车沿着轨道行驶。
words.en: A locomotive is a powered rail vehicle used for pulling trains.

words.ex: The boat travels through the canal.
words.ex_cn: 船通过运河航行。
words.en: A canal is a long, narrow stretch of water that has been made for boats to travel along or to bring water to a particular area.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: She washed the linen in cold water.
words.ex_cn: 她用冷水洗亚麻布。
words.en: Linen is a kind of cloth that is made from the fibers of the flax plant. It is used to make clothes, sheets, and tablecloths.

words.ex: She wore a dress made of cotton.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件棉质裙子。
words.en: Cotton is a plant that produces a soft fiber which is used to make cloth or thread. Cotton is also the cloth or thread that is made from this fiber.

words.ex: Prior to the meeting, we reviewed the report.
words.ex_cn: 在会议之前，我们复习了报告。
words.en: Existing or coming before in time, order, or importance.

words.ex: They live in a small cottage near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小村舍里。
words.en: A cottage is a small house, usually in the countryside.

words.tr: n. 纺纱机；纺纱工；转盘
words.ex: The spinner turned wool into thread.
words.ex_cn: 这台纺纱机将羊毛纺成线。
words.en: A spinner is a person or machine that spins wool, cotton, or other material into thread or yarn.

words.ex: The weaver makes beautiful cloth by hand.
words.ex_cn: 织布工手工制作美丽的布料。
words.en: A weaver is a person who weaves fabric or baskets.

words.ex: The dyer colored the fabric with natural dyes.
words.ex_cn: 染色工用天然染料给布料染色。
words.en: A dyer is a person whose job is to dye cloth or other materials.

words.tr:
n. 织布机；
v. 迫近；
words.ex: The old loom made a loud clicking sound.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧织布机发出很大的咔嗒声。
words.en: If something looms over you, it appears as a large or unclear shape, often in a way that is frightening or causes worry.

words.ex: She spun wool into yarn to make a sweater.
words.ex_cn: 她把羊毛纺成纱线来织毛衣。
words.en: Yarn is a long, continuous length of interlocked fibers, suitable for use in the production of textiles, sewing, crocheting, knitting, weaving, embroidery, or ropemaking.

words.ex: She picked up a thread from the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她从布料上捡起一根线。
words.en: A thread is a long, thin strand of cotton, nylon, or other fibers used in sewing or weaving. It can also refer to a theme or idea that connects parts of a story or discussion.

words.ex: He went abroad to study medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他去国外学医。
words.en: In or to a foreign country or countries.

words.ex: The bridge is made of iron.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用铁建造的。
words.en: Iron is a strong hard metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food.

words.ex: He had to undergo surgery last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周不得不接受手术。
words.en: If you undergo something necessary or unpleasant, it happens to you or is done to you.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；首要的；
n. 领袖；首领；
words.ex: He is the chief reason for the team's success.
words.ex_cn: 他是球队成功的主要原因。
words.en: The chief is the leader of a group or organization, or the main part of something.

words.tr:
v. 熔炼；冶炼
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；“smell”的过去式和过去分词
n. 胡瓜鱼
words.ex: They smelt iron ore to make steel.
words.ex_cn: 他们熔炼铁矿石来制造钢铁。
words.en: To smelt means to extract metal from ore by a process involving heating and melting.

words.ex: The miners dug deep to find iron ore.
words.ex_cn: 矿工们深入地下寻找铁矿石。
words.en: Ore is rock or earth from which metal can be obtained.

words.ex: The factory uses coke to heat the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用焦炭来加热熔炉。
words.en: Coke is a solid fuel made by heating coal in the absence of air so that the volatile components are driven off. It is also a popular brand of soft drink.

words.ex: He drew a picture with charcoal.
words.ex_cn: 他用木炭画了一幅画。
words.en: Charcoal is a black substance made by burning wood slowly in an oven with little air, used for drawing or as a fuel.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.ex: He learned telegraphy to send messages across long distances.
words.ex_cn: 他学习电信技术以发送长距离信息。
words.en: Telegraphy is the long-distance transmission of textual or symbolic messages without the physical exchange of an object bearing the message.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The car crash was a serious collision.
words.ex_cn: 那场车祸是一次严重的碰撞。
words.en: A collision occurs when two or more objects come into contact with each other, often resulting in damage or a change in direction.

words.ex: The mountain is immense.
words.ex_cn: 这座山非常巨大。
words.en: Extremely large or great, especially in scale or degree.

words.ex: The city is facing problems because of rapid urbanization.
words.ex_cn: 由于快速的城市化，这座城市正面临问题。
words.en: The process by which more and more people leave the countryside to live in cities.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: The food supply was inadequate for the number of people.
words.ex_cn: 食物供应对人数来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is inadequate, there is not enough of it or it is not good enough.

words.tr: n. 公共卫生；卫生设施；
words.ex: The city improved sanitation to keep people healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了公共卫生以保障人民健康。
words.en: The conditions and processes that help maintain health and prevent disease, especially through cleanliness.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.ex: He receives his wage every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A wage is the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for manual or unskilled work. To wage means to carry on (a war or campaign).

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: The opposition to the new law was strong.
words.ex_cn: 对这项新法律的反对很强烈。
words.en: Opposition is strong disagreement with or resistance to something, especially a plan, policy, or government.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: She knit a warm scarf for her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她为她的弟弟织了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: If you knit something, especially an article of clothing, you make it from wool or a similar thread by using two knitting needles or a machine.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: The thieves robbed the bank last night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷昨晚抢劫了银行。
words.en: To rob someone or somewhere means to take money or property illegally from them, often using force.

words.ex: Farming is his main livelihood.
words.ex_cn: 务农是他的主要生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood is the way they earn money in order to live.

words.tr: adj. 不顾一切的；极度渴望的；绝望的；
words.ex: He made a desperate attempt to save the child.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾一切地试图救那个孩子。
words.en: If you are desperate, you are in such a bad situation that you are willing to try anything to change it.

words.ex: He smashed the glass with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把玻璃打碎了。
words.en: To break something into pieces violently and noisily, or to cause something to do this by dropping, throwing, or hitting it.

words.ex: He is an apprentice in a car repair shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是汽车修理店的一名学徒。
words.en: An apprentice is a young person who works for someone in order to learn their skill.

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: There is a rumour that he will quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 有一个传言说他要辞职。
words.en: A rumour is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.ex: The soldiers ran through the gunfire to reach safety.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们穿过炮火到达安全地带。
words.en: Gunfire is the repeated shooting of guns.

words.tr:
n. 保卫；警卫；
v. 守卫；
words.ex: The guard stands at the gate to protect the building.
words.ex_cn: 保卫人员站在门口保护大楼。
words.en: A guard is a person who protects a place, person, or thing, or who prevents people from escaping from a place.

words.ex: The soldier walks to the camp every morning.
words.ex_cn: 士兵每天早上步行去营地。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.ex: The people started an uprising against the unfair rules.
words.ex_cn: 人们因不公平的规则而发动了起义。
words.en: An uprising is a violent act of opposition by many people in one area against those who are in power there.

words.ex: The old mill stands by the river.
words.ex_cn: 旧磨坊坐落在河边。
words.en: A mill is a building in which grain is crushed to make flour. It can also refer to a factory where certain materials are processed or manufactured.

words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest you, they take charge of you and take you to a police station, because they believe you may have committed a crime.

words.tr:
v. 悬挂；吊；
n. 悬挂；
words.ex: He hangs a picture on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一幅画挂在墙上。
words.en: To hang something means to attach it to something else so that it is supported from above and does not touch the ground.

words.ex: The people showed resistance against the unfair law.
words.ex_cn: 人们对这项不公平的法律表示抵抗。
words.en: Resistance is the refusal to accept or comply with something; the attempt to prevent something by action or argument.

words.tr: v. 销声匿迹；突然消失；
words.ex: The magic trick made the coin vanish.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让硬币销声匿迹了。
words.en: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear suddenly or in a way that cannot be explained.

words.ex: The withdrawal of the offer surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 撤销这项提议让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The act of removing or taking something away, especially money from a bank account, or the process of stopping taking a drug or medicine.

words.ex: He won the chess tournament last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周赢得了国际象棋锦标赛。
words.en: A tournament is a competition in which players who win a match continue to play further matches in the competition until just one person or team is left.

words.ex: The bees made a loud buzz near the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在花附近发出嗡嗡声。
words.en: To make a low, continuous, humming or sibilant sound, like that made by bees or flies.

words.ex: The rain was unavoidable during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨期间，下雨是不可避免的。
words.en: If something is unavoidable, it cannot be avoided or prevented.

words.ex: She typically arrives early for class.
words.ex_cn: 她往往很早就到课。
words.en: You use typically to say that something usually happens in the way that you are describing.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: A resource is a source or supply from which benefit is produced. Typically resources are materials, energy, services, staff, knowledge, or other assets that are transformed to produce benefit and in the process may be consumed or made unavailable.

words.ex: He defeated his opponent in the chess game.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: An opponent is someone who is competing against you in a contest, game, or argument, or someone who is opposed to an idea or plan.

words.ex: He will tackle the problem tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会处理这个问题。
words.en: If you tackle a problem or task, you deal with it in a determined way. In sports such as football and rugby, a tackle is an act of trying to take the ball from a player on the other team.

words.ex: He felt adrenaline when he jumped from the plane.
words.ex_cn: 当他从飞机上跳下时，感受到了肾上腺素。
words.en: A hormone secreted by the adrenal glands, especially in conditions of stress, increasing rates of blood circulation, breathing, and carbohydrate metabolism and preparing muscles for exertion.

words.ex: Stress makes your body produce more cortisol.
words.ex_cn: 压力会使你的身体产生更多的皮质醇。
words.en: Cortisol is a steroid hormone, in the glucocorticoid class of hormones. When used as a medication, it is known as hydrocortisone. It is produced in humans by the zona fasciculata of the adrenal cortex within the adrenal gland.

words.tr: v. 效劳；服务；为……工作；招待；
words.ex: He serves the community as a volunteer.
words.ex_cn: 他作为志愿者为社区效劳。
words.en: To perform duties or services for (a person or an organization).

words.ex: He wiped away the perspiration from his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他擦去了额头上的汗。
words.en: Perspiration is the process of sweating, or the sweat itself, that occurs in humans and some animals as a way of regulating body temperature.

words.ex: He felt a palpitation after running fast.
words.ex_cn: 他快速跑步后感到心跳加速。
words.en: A palpitation is an unusually rapid, strong, or irregular heartbeat that you are aware of, often described as a fluttering or pounding sensation in the chest.

words.ex: The earthquake caused a strong tremor in the building.
words.ex_cn: 地震使大楼发生了强烈的震动。
words.en: A tremor is a small earthquake or a shaking or vibrating movement, especially one caused by fear or nervousness.

words.ex: The smell of the food made her feel nausea.
words.ex_cn: 食物的气味让她感到恶心。
words.en: A feeling of sickness with an inclination to vomit.

words.ex: His sadness manifested in his quiet eyes.
words.ex_cn: 他的悲伤表现在他安静的眼神中。
words.en: To manifest something means to show it clearly and visibly.

words.tr: n. 事件；一集；一段经历；
words.ex: The accident was a sad episode in his life.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是他生命中的一件悲伤的事。
words.en: An episode is a part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio as one of a series, or a single event or group of related events.

words.ex: The nerve in his finger was damaged.
words.ex_cn: 他手指里的神经受到了损伤。
words.en: A nerve is a bundle of fibers that transmits impulses of sensation to the brain or spinal cord, and impulses from these to the muscles and organs. It also refers to the courage or control needed to do something difficult or dangerous.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.tr: n. 道德规范；伦理标准；
words.ex: The company follows a strong ethic of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司遵循诚实的道德规范。
words.en: An ethic is a moral principle or set of moral principles that guides the behavior of a person or group, especially in a professional context.

words.tr: n. 副产品 ；让产易股；资产分派
words.ex: The movie was a spin-off of the popular TV series.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是那部热门电视剧的副产品。
words.en: A spin-off is something that develops from something larger or more important, especially a television program or film that is based on a character or idea from an existing one.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: She is the epitome of kindness.
words.ex_cn: 她是善良的典型。
words.en: A person or thing that is a perfect example of a particular quality or type.

words.ex: His determination helped him finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他的决心帮助他完成了比赛。
words.en: Determination is the quality that you show when you have decided to do something and you will not let anything stop you.

words.ex: He was undeterred by the bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 他没有被糟糕的天气吓住。
words.en: If you are undeterred by something, you are not discouraged or prevented from doing something by it.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.tr:
n. 等价物；
adj. 相等的；等价的；
words.ex: The dollar is the equivalent of ten yuan.
words.ex_cn: 美元是十元的等价物。
words.en: If one amount or value is the equivalent of another, they are the same.

words.ex: She has an extraordinary talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 她具有非凡的音乐天赋。
words.en: Something that is extraordinary is very unusual or remarkable.

words.ex: The ball is a perfect sphere.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是一个完美的球体。
words.en: A sphere is a perfectly round three-dimensional shape, like a ball. It can also refer to a particular area of interest, activity, or knowledge.

words.tr: adj. 选择性的；精挑细选的；
words.ex: He is selective about what he eats.
words.ex_cn: 他对吃的东西很挑剔。
words.en: If you are selective, you choose things carefully, for example, the things that you buy or do.

words.tr: v. 强烈吸引住；使着迷；
words.ex: The magic show fascinated the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演深深吸引了孩子们。
words.en: If something fascinates you, it interests and delights you so much that your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.tr:
n. 钩；挂钩；
v. 钩住；
words.ex: The key hung on a metal hook.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙挂在金属钩上。
words.en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things on.

words.tr: adj. 坚决的；毅然的；有决心的；
words.ex: He was resolute in his decision to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他决心戒烟。
words.en: If you describe someone as resolute, you approve of them because they are very determined not to change their mind or not to give up a course of action.

words.ex: He had a setback when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，遇到了挫折。
words.en: A setback is an event that delays your progress or reverses some of the progress that you have made.

words.tr:
n. 小径；路径；踪迹；
v. 跟踪；尾随；落后于；
words.ex: We walked along the forest trail.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着森林小径散步。
words.en: A trail is a path through the countryside or through a forest, often made or used by people walking. As a verb, to trail means to follow someone or something secretly or to be behind in a race or competition.

words.ex: His performance was unexceptional.
words.ex_cn: 他的表现很平常。
words.en: If you describe something as unexceptional, you mean that it is ordinary, not very interesting, or not especially good.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持不懈地做；埋头苦干；持续努力
words.ex: He plugs away at his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都埋头做作业。
words.en: To continue working hard at something, especially when it is difficult or takes a long time.

words.ex: Einstein developed the theory of relativity.
words.ex_cn: 爱因斯坦提出了相对论。
words.en: The theory of relativity, developed by Albert Einstein, fundamentally altered our understanding of space, time, and gravity.

words.ex: He has a considerable amount of money.
words.ex_cn: 他有相当多的钱。
words.en: Considerable means large in size, amount, or extent.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: The baby's neural connections are developing fast.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿的神经连接正在迅速发展。
words.en: Neural relates to a nerve or the nervous system.

words.ex: The dirt pathway led to the small house.
words.ex_cn: 这条土路通向那座小房子。
words.en: A pathway is a track that is made by or for people walking, especially one through a countryside or a park.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: The jury decided the man was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团裁定这个人无罪。
words.en: A jury is a group of people who are chosen to decide whether someone is guilty or not guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.ex: Babies have an innate ability to cry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿生来就有哭泣的能力。
words.en: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

words.ex: This experiment is replicable by anyone with basic tools.
words.ex_cn: 任何有基本工具的人都可以复制这个实验。
words.en: Capable of being replicated or copied.

words.ex: Honesty is a good trait.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种好的特性。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.ex: They collaborate to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作完成这个项目。
words.en: to work jointly with others or together especially in an intellectual endeavor

words.ex: He is learning neuroscience at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习神经科学。
words.en: The scientific study of the nervous system, especially the brain.

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.ex: His persistence helped him pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他的坚持让他通过了考试。
words.en: Persistence is the determination to do something even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: He is an eminent scientist who won the Nobel Prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位获得诺贝尔奖的杰出科学家。
words.en: An eminent person is well-known and respected, especially because they are good at their profession.

words.tr:
adj. 深思熟虑的；故意的；
v. 深思熟虑；
words.ex: He made a deliberate choice to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他深思熟虑后决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you do something that is deliberate, you planned or decided to do it beforehand, and so it happens on purpose rather than by chance.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.ex: He picked a random number to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他随意选了一个数字来赢得奖品。
words.en: If you describe something as random, you mean that it happens or is chosen without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.ex: He learned a new technique to paint better.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一种新的绘画技术。
words.en: A technique is a particular method of doing an activity, usually a method that involves practical skills.

words.ex: He outperforms his classmates in math tests.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中表现优于同学。
words.en: To perform better than someone or something else.

words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as superior, you mean that they are better than other people or things.

words.tr: v. 区分；“distinguish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 卓越的；著名的；
words.ex: He distinguished the fake coin from the real one.
words.ex_cn: 他把假硬币和真硬币区分开来。
words.en: If you describe a person or their work as distinguished, you mean that they have been very successful in their career and have a good reputation.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.ex: The pattern of the wallpaper is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 墙纸的图案非常简单。
words.en: A pattern is the repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.ex: He consistently arrives at school on time.
words.ex_cn: 他一贯准时到校。
words.en: In a way that does not vary; in the same way over time.

words.ex: The archeologist digs old pots in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 考古学家在沙漠中挖掘古老的陶器。
words.en: An archeologist is a person who studies the buildings, graves, tools, and other objects of people who lived in the past.

words.tr:
v. 搜寻；（动物）觅食；
n. 饲料；草料；
words.ex: The bear forages for berries in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只熊在森林里搜寻浆果。
words.en: If you forage, you search for food or other supplies. Forage can also refer to food for animals, especially when it is grown or collected.

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.ex: The excavation revealed ancient pottery.
words.ex_cn: 挖掘发现了古代陶器。
words.en: The process of digging up and removing earth, especially at an archaeological site.

words.ex: The police dispersed the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 警察驱散了人群。
words.en: If a crowd of people disperses or is dispersed, it breaks up and the people go in different directions.

words.ex: The Philippines is an archipelago of thousands of islands.
words.ex_cn: 菲律宾是一个由数千个岛屿组成的群岛。
words.en: An archipelago is a group of islands, especially small islands, scattered in a body of water.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: Birds begin migration in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在秋天开始迁徙。
words.en: The movement of people, animals, or birds from one place to another, especially regularly according to the seasons.

words.ex: The pyramids were built over millennia.
words.ex_cn: 这些金字塔是在数千年间建造的。
words.en: Millennia is the plural form of millennium, which refers to a period of a thousand years.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.ex: The glass broke into small fragments.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃碎成了小碎片。
words.en: A fragment of something is a small piece or part of it.

words.ex: He picked up an axe to chop wood.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把斧子去砍柴。
words.en: An axe is a tool used for chopping wood, typically consisting of a heavy metal blade fixed at a right angle at the end of a long handle. As a verb, to axe means to dismiss or reduce something drastically.

words.ex: He found a clam on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上发现了一只蛤。
words.en: A clam is a type of shellfish with a shell in two parts that can open and close. Clams can be eaten as food.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: The thick forest was impenetrable.
words.ex_cn: 这片茂密的森林无法穿越。
words.en: Impenetrable is used to describe something that cannot be passed through, entered, or understood.

words.ex: The book encompasses all basic math skills.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包含了所有基础数学技能。
words.en: If something encompasses particular things, it includes them.

words.ex: It's a coincidence that we both wore blue today.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天都穿了蓝色，真是巧合。
words.en: A coincidence is when two or more similar or related events occur at the same time by chance and without any planning.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.ex: The modification improved the design.
words.ex_cn: 这个修改改进了设计。
words.en: A modification is a change or alteration made to something to improve it or to make it suitable for a different purpose.

words.ex: He grinds the coffee beans into powder.
words.ex_cn: 他把咖啡豆碾成粉末。
words.en: To reduce something to small particles or powder by crushing it.

words.ex: The edge of the table is sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的边缘很锋利。
words.en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

words.ex: They unearthed an old coin in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他们在花园里挖出了一枚旧硬币。
words.en: To unearth something means to find it by digging in the ground or to discover something that was hidden or unknown.

words.ex: The creature lived in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这个生物生活在森林里。
words.en: A creature is a living thing, especially an animal.

words.ex: He planted carrots in a small patch.
words.ex_cn: 他在一小块地上种了胡萝卜。
words.en: A patch is a piece of material used to mend a hole or a weak spot in something, or a small area that is different from the area around it.

words.ex: The volcanic eruption destroyed the village.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷发摧毁了村庄。
words.en: Volcanic is used to describe things that are connected with volcanoes or caused by volcanoes.

words.ex: Water is a common substance.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的物质。
words.en: A substance is a particular kind of matter with uniform properties.

words.ex: The ancient tool was made of obsidian.
words.ex_cn: 这个古代工具是由黑曜石制成的。
words.en: Obsidian is a naturally occurring volcanic glass formed as an extrusive igneous rock.

words.ex: She threaded a bead onto the string.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗有孔的小珠穿在绳子上。
words.en: A bead is a small piece of glass, wood, or plastic that is used for decorating clothes or making jewellery.

words.ex: He routinely checks his email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上例行检查邮件。
words.en: If something is routinely done, it is done as a normal part of a job or process.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.ex: The departure of the train was at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火车的出发时间是晚上8点。
words.en: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；
v. 分阶段进行；
words.ex: The project is in its final phase.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正处于最后阶段。
words.en: A phase is a particular stage in a process or in the gradual development of something.

words.ex: She added cinnamon spice to the cake.
words.ex_cn: 她往蛋糕里加了肉桂香料。
words.en: Spice refers to a substance used to flavor food, which is usually made from parts of plants, especially their seeds, fruits, or roots. It can also mean something that adds interest or excitement.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.ex: The city improved its drainage system after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 洪水之后，这座城市改进了它的排水系统。
words.en: Drainage is the system or process by which water or other liquids are drained from a place.

words.ex: The police discovered a scheme to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 警方发现了一个偷钱的阴谋。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret plan to do something, especially something illegal or dishonest.

words.ex: The extraction of coal harms the environment.
words.ex_cn: 煤炭的开采对环境有害。
words.en: The process of removing or obtaining something from something else.

words.ex: Farmers use pesticide to kill insects on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的昆虫。
words.en: A pesticide is a chemical substance used to kill pests, especially insects, that damage crops or are harmful to human health.

words.ex: The factory releases a pollutant into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河里排放一种污染物。
words.en: A pollutant is a substance that pollutes something, especially air, water, or soil.

words.ex: He has a considerable amount of money.
words.ex_cn: 他有相当多的钱。
words.en: Considerable means large in size, amount, or extent.

words.ex: He visits a religious temple every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都去一座宗教寺庙。
words.en: Relating to or believing in a religion.

words.ex: They found an archaeological site near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他们在河边发现了一个考古遗址。
words.en: Relating to the study of human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and the analysis of artifacts and other physical remains.

words.ex: Farming is his main livelihood.
words.ex_cn: 务农是他的主要生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood is the way they earn money in order to live.

words.ex: Exercise helps with your well-being.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有助于你的健康。
words.en: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；决定性的；
words.ex: It is crucial to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水至关重要。
words.en: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

words.ex: Planting trees can mitigate air pollution.
words.ex_cn: 植树可以减轻空气污染。
words.en: To mitigate something means to make it less unpleasant, serious, or painful.

words.ex: The computer uses a buffer to store data temporarily.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用缓冲区临时存储数据。
words.en: A buffer is something that prevents something else from being harmed or that reduces the impact of something.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.ex: The coastal village has beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个沿海村庄有美丽的海滩。
words.en: relating to the coast, the area where the land meets the sea

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.ex: The farmer owns five hectares of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有五公顷土地。
words.en: A hectare is a unit of measurement of area, equal to 10,000 square metres or approximately 2.471 acres.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.ex: Wheat is a basic commodity in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 小麦在许多国家是一种基本商品。
words.en: A commodity is something that is bought and sold.

words.tr: adj. 涝的；浸满水的，吸饱水的；浸满水（waterlog 的过去分词）；
words.ex: The field was waterlogged after the heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 大雨过后，这片田地涝了。
words.en: If something is waterlogged, it is so full of water or so wet that it cannot absorb any more.

words.ex: The farmer's cultivation of rice takes months.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植水稻需要几个月的时间。
words.en: The process of trying to acquire or develop a quality or skill.

words.ex: The emitter sends out light.
words.ex_cn: 发射器发出光。
words.en: An entity, such as a factory or vehicle, that releases something, typically greenhouse gases, into the atmosphere.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.tr:
n. （木材）采运作业；
v. 把……载入正式记录；
words.ex: The company increased its logging in the northern forest.
words.ex_cn: 该公司增加了在北部森林的木材采运作业。
words.en: The activity or business of felling trees and cutting and preparing the timber.

words.ex: The farmer dug a ditch to water the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农夫挖了一条沟来给田地浇水。
words.en: A ditch is a long narrow trench or furrow dug in the ground, especially for drainage or irrigation.

words.ex: The swamp is full of tall grass and frogs.
words.ex_cn: 这个沼泽里长满了高草和青蛙。
words.en: A swamp is an area of low-lying, uncultivated ground where water collects; a bog or marsh.

words.ex: Bacteria can make you sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌会让你生病。
words.en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause diseases.

words.tr: n. 霉菌；菌类；真菌；“fungus”的复数；
words.ex: The bread has fungi growing on it.
words.ex_cn: 面包上长了霉菌。
words.en: Fungi are a group of living organisms which are classified in their own kingdom. This means they are not animals, plants, or bacteria. Fungi include mushrooms, molds, and yeasts.

words.ex: Methane is a gas that comes from cows and landfills.
words.ex_cn: 甲烷是一种来自牛和垃圾填埋场的气体。
words.en: A colorless, odorless flammable gas which is the main constituent of natural gas. It is the simplest member of the alkane series of hydrocarbons.

words.ex: The remainder of the cake was given to the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的剩余部分给了邻居。
words.en: The remainder is what is left over after other parts have been taken away or used.

words.ex: The team comprises five players and one coach.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队包括五名球员和一名教练。
words.en: If you say that something comprises or is comprised of a number of things or people, you mean it has them as its parts or members.

words.tr: adj. 使人惊恐的；引起恐慌的； v. “alarm”的现在分词；
words.ex: The news report showed an alarming rise in crimes.
words.ex_cn: 新闻报道显示犯罪率令人惊恐地上升。
words.en: If something is alarming, it makes you feel afraid or anxious that something unpleasant or dangerous might happen.

words.ex: The ground began to subside after the heavy rain.
words.ex_cn: 大雨之后，地面开始下陷。
words.en: If a feeling or noise subsides, it becomes less strong or loud.

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.tr: adj. 毁灭性的； v. “devastate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The earthquake caused devastating damage to the city.
words.ex_cn: 地震对这座城市造成了毁灭性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as devastating, you are emphasizing that it is very harmful or damaging.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.tr:
adj. 深思熟虑的；故意的；
v. 深思熟虑；
words.ex: He made a deliberate choice to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他深思熟虑后决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you do something that is deliberate, you planned or decided to do it beforehand, and so it happens on purpose rather than by chance.

words.ex: He finally acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: My generation grew up with smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 我们这一代人是伴随着智能手机长大的。
words.en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: The city plans for sustainability by using solar energy.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市通过使用太阳能来实现可持续性。
words.en: Sustainability is the ability to maintain or support a process continuously over time. In the context of environmental science, it refers to the avoidance of the depletion of natural resources in order to maintain an ecological balance.

words.ex: He lost his fortune in the stock market.
words.ex_cn: 他在股市中失去了他的财产。
words.en: A large amount of money or assets; chance or luck as an external force in human affairs.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.tr: adv. 谨慎地；小心翼翼地；
words.ex: He walked cautiously across the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 他小心翼翼地走过结冰的路。
words.en: If you do something cautiously, you do it carefully in order to avoid possible danger or problems.

words.ex: He is optimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持乐观态度。
words.en: Someone who is optimistic is hopeful about the future or the success of something in particular.

words.ex: The pollution caused the degradation of the river.
words.ex_cn: 污染导致了河流的恶化。
words.en: The process by which something is reduced in quality, value, or status.

words.ex: The scratchy record made a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 这张发出刮擦声的唱片发出了很大的噪音。
words.en: If something is scratchy, it makes an unpleasant rough sound, or it feels rough and uncomfortable.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.tr: n. 说明或对白的字幕；副标题；
words.ex: The movie has English subtitles for the dialogue.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影为对白提供了英文字幕。
words.en: A subtitle is a secondary or explanatory title, or a translation of the dialogue in a film or television program, displayed at the bottom of the screen.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.ex: This is a commonplace event in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 这在大城市里是件普通的事。
words.en: Something that is commonplace is ordinary and not very interesting.

words.ex: The engineer built a prototype of the new car.
words.ex_cn: 工程师制作了这辆新车的原型。
words.en: A prototype is the first or original example of something that has been or will be copied or developed; it is a model or preliminary version.

words.tr: adj. 引人注目的；显眼的
words.ex: The poster is eye-catching with bright colors.
words.ex_cn: 这张海报用鲜艳的颜色很引人注目。
words.en: Something that is eye-catching is very noticeable because it is unusual or attractive.

words.ex: The toy store sells many novelty items for children.
words.ex_cn: 玩具店出售许多为儿童设计的新奇物品。
words.en: The quality of being new, original, or unusual; something new, original, or unusual.

words.tr: v. 兑现；递送；交付；发表；为…接生；
words.ex: He promised to deliver on his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要兑现自己的目标。
words.en: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.

words.ex: He wears an earpiece to hear the teacher clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴一个耳机以便听清老师的话。
words.en: A device worn on or in the ear to listen to audio signals privately.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.ex: The two events happened simultaneously.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件同时发生了。
words.en: Happening, existing, or done at the same time.

words.ex: The law obliges drivers to wear seat belts.
words.ex_cn: 法律迫使司机系安全带。
words.en: If you are obliged to do something, you have to do it because the situation, the law, a duty, etc., makes it necessary.

words.ex: He felt apprehension before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到焦虑。
words.en: Anxiety or fear that something bad or unpleasant will happen; understanding; the action of arresting someone.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.ex: He knows good etiquette at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他知道晚餐时的礼貌规矩。
words.en: Etiquette refers to the customary code of polite behavior in society or among members of a particular profession or group.

words.ex: The company decided to outsource its customer service.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司决定将客户服务外购。
words.en: If a company outsources work or things, it pays workers from outside the company to do the work or supply the things.

words.tr: adj. 无（接）缝的；无漏洞的；
words.ex: The software has a seamless interface.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件有一个无缝的界面。
words.en: Something that is seamless has no obvious joins or gaps between its different parts.

words.ex: Smartphones are ubiquitous in modern life.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机在现代生活中无处不在。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as ubiquitous, you mean that they seem to be everywhere.

words.tr: adj. 值得注意的；显著的；
words.ex: This result is noteworthy because it changes our understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个结果值得注意，因为它改变了我们的理解。
words.en: If you describe something as noteworthy, you mean that it is interesting, significant, or important enough to deserve attention or to be noticed.

words.tr:
n. 变种；变体
v. 改变；变化
words.ex: This butterfly has a rare morph with blue wings.
words.ex_cn: 这种蝴蝶有一种罕见的蓝色翅膀变种。
words.en: To morph means to change smoothly from one image to another by small gradual steps using computer animation techniques.

words.ex: We watched a dubbed movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部配音电影。
words.en: A movie that has been translated into another language by replacing the original dialogue with a new voice track.

words.ex: English is a lingua franca in international business.
words.ex_cn: 英语是国际商务中的通用语言。
words.en: A lingua franca is a language or way of communicating which is used between people who do not speak one another's native language.

words.tr: n. 前任；前辈；原有事物
words.ex: He became the new manager, replacing his predecessor.
words.ex_cn: 他成为了新经理，接替了他的前任。
words.en: A predecessor is someone who had a job or a position before someone else, or something that comes before another thing in time or in a series.

words.tr: n. 自然环境保护主义者
words.ex: The conservationist protects wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这位环保主义者保护野生动物。
words.en: A conservationist is someone who works to protect the environment, especially natural resources and wildlife.

words.tr: phrase. 连锁反应：引起其他事情发生的影响。
words.ex: The factory closed, and had a knock-on effect on local shops.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭了，对当地商店产生了连锁影响。
words.en: A knock-on effect is a situation where one event causes a series of other events to happen one after another.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.ex: The caterpillar is eating leaves on the tree.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫正在树上吃叶子。
words.en: A caterpillar is a small, worm-like animal that eventually develops into a butterfly or moth.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.ex: The quantity of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: A quantity is an amount that you can measure or count.

words.ex: A dog is a mammal.
words.ex_cn: 狗是一种哺乳动物。
words.en: A mammal is a type of animal that feeds its young with milk produced by the mother's body. Mammals are warm-blooded and usually have hair or fur.

words.tr:
n. 手臂；
v. 武装；
words.ex: He raised his arm to wave hello.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手臂打招呼。
words.en: An arm is one of the two long parts of your body that are attached to your shoulders and that have your hands at the end.

words.tr:
v. 中断；暂停；
n. 停顿下来；
words.ex: The storm halted the flight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴中断了航班。
words.en: to bring or come to a stop; a temporary or permanent stop

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.tr: v. 较喜欢；更喜欢；宁愿；
words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you prefer someone or something, you like that person or thing better than another, and so you are more likely to choose them if there is a choice.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: Fish reproduce in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在河里繁殖。
words.en: To produce something again; to make a copy of something.

words.tr: n. 时间的安排；时间的选择； v. “time”的现在分词；
words.ex: The timing of the meeting was perfect.
words.ex_cn: 会议的时间安排恰到好处。
words.en: Timing is the skill or action of judging the right moment in a situation or activity at which to do something.

words.ex: Scientists study phenology to track when flowers bloom.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究物候学来追踪花朵何时开放。
words.en: The study of cyclic and seasonal natural phenomena, especially in relation to climate and plant and animal life.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.ex: He keeps in line with the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守学校的规章制度。
words.en: To act in accordance with or to conform to a particular standard or expectation.

words.ex: The school will equip the lab with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 学校将为实验室配备新电脑。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He answered the question unwillingly.
words.ex_cn: 他不情愿地回答了问题。
words.en: In a way that shows you do not want to do something.

words.ex: He will submit his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会提交他的作业。
words.en: To yield or surrender (oneself) to the will or authority of another.

words.tr: n. 热心者；热衷于…的人
words.ex: He is an enthusiast of basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球的爱好者。
words.en: An enthusiast is a person who is very interested in a particular activity or subject and who spends a lot of time on it.

words.ex: There is an abundance of food at the party.
words.ex_cn: 聚会上食物非常丰富。
words.en: A very large quantity of something.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.tr:
adj. 可变的；易变的；
n. 变量；
words.ex: The weather is variable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: A variable is something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation.

words.ex: The emergence of new technology changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 新技术的出现改变了我们的生活。
words.en: The process of coming into view or becoming exposed after being concealed.

words.ex: She wore a dainty necklace with tiny pearls.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一条小巧精致的珍珠项链。
words.en: If you describe something as dainty, you mean that it is small, delicate, and pretty.

words.tr: n. 群体；殖民地；聚居地；
words.ex: A colony of ants moved quickly across the ground.
words.ex_cn: 一群蚂蚁迅速从地上爬过。
